Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner overlooked already-visible information in the prior WebSurfer result stating that Theuderich I was the father of Theudebert I, then later relied on an inaccurate search snippet conflating Theuderic I with Theodoric the Great without verifying the source. This misinterpretation and failure to cross-check led to the incorrect final answer that Wisigard’s father-in-law was Theodoric the Great, whereas it should be Theuderic I.
